people.name: Pratapaditya Pal
people.field: Southeast Asian and Himalayan art and culture

relations.subject: Pratapaditya Pal
relations.evidence: Studying at the University of Calcutta... in 1957, and he instead obtained a Master of Arts degree in ancient Indian history and culture.

relations.subject: Pratapaditya Pal
relations.evidence: He continued at the university to earn a PhD in the history of Nepali architecture in 1962.

relations.subject: Pratapaditya Pal
relations.evidence: He then won a scholarship to Cambridge University, where in 1965 he earned a second PhD in Nepali sculpture and painting.

relations.subject: Pratapaditya Pal
relations.role: curator of the Indian art collection
relations.evidence: In 1967 Pal was appointed the curator of the Indian art collection at Boston Museum, a position that had previously been held by Ananda Coomaraswamy.

relations.subject: Pratapaditya Pal
relations.object: Los Angeles County Museum of Art
relations.role: head of department of Indian and Islamic art
relations.evidence: In 1969, he moved to the Los Angeles County Museum of Art... Pal joined as the head of department of Indian and Islamic art

relations.subject: Pratapaditya Pal
relations.object: Los Angeles County Museum of Art
relations.evidence: subsequently served as the museum's acting director (1979–80)

relations.subject: Pratapaditya Pal
relations.object: Los Angeles County Museum of Art
relations.role: senior curator of Indian and Southeast Asian art
relations.evidence: and as the senior curator of Indian and Southeast Asian art from 1981.

relations.subject: Pratapaditya Pal
relations.role: visiting curator of Indian, Himalayan and Southeast Asian Art
relations.evidence: In 1995, Pal was appointed visiting curator of Indian, Himalayan and Southeast Asian Art at The Art Institute of Chicago.

relations.subject: Pratapaditya Pal
relations.evidence: He moved to Norton Simon Museum, Pasadena, California in 2003.

relations.subject: Pratapaditya Pal
relations.evidence: and served as the editor of the Indian art magazine, Marg.
